metadata.description: Area of interest envelope for Dong Nai province, Vietnam.
metadata.provenance: Rectangular envelope derived from the published extent of Dong Nai province (approximately 10.50N-11.60N, 106.35E-107.60E). This is NOT an authoritative administrative boundary. It is a search envelope used for Sentinel-2 catalogue discovery only.
